children: The Australian dollar remains near its year‑to‑date lows against the U.S. dollar and is weak against most of the cross rates too, says Joe Capurso, economist at CBA. The weak Australian jobs report for October on Thursday has led to a reassessment of the future path of the Reserve Bank of Australia's cash rate, he adds. It's a case of out with pricing a chance of a hike and in with 33 bps of cuts priced by this time next year. Unemployment rate divergence between the U.S. and Australia is causing interest rate convergence that is weighing on the pair, he says. The Australian dollar is trading around 66.48 U.S. cents.
